operating_notes.text: Combined installed reactor capacity was 791 KL with 39 assembly lines as of 31 March 2026.
SDA revenue rose to ₹204.5 Cr in FY26 from ₹119.7 Cr in FY25, taking its share of revenue to 41% from 31%.
Exports were 75% of revenue in FY25, per the presentation.
Peak potential revenue from current Dahej facility is estimated around ₹850 crores to ₹900 crores.
Trade receivables rose to ₹178.38 Cr at Sep-2026 from ₹119.03 Cr at Mar-2026.
Inventories rose to ₹248.91 Cr at Sep-2026 from ₹196.07 Cr at Mar-2026.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was negative ₹3.68 Cr against ₹13.38 Cr inflow in H1FY26.
Solvent prices surged 60%-100% due to erratic short supplies during Q2FY27, while global freight costs in US and Europe rose over 100%.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹134.14 Cr (+24.4% YoY), net profit ₹10.32 Cr (+901.9% YoY).
Tatva Chintan released its investor presentation for Q4FY26 and FY26 highlighting financial recovery and operational capacity.
Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Limited shared earnings call recording held on 16 May 2026 at 05:00 PM IST via its website.
Tatva Chintan held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 16, 2026, reporting 24% YoY revenue growth and outlining expansion plans for its Jolva facility.
Ajay Mansukhlal Patel, along with 9 other promoters and Star Enterprise, declared no encumbrance of Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem shares during FY2026.
Chintan Nitinkumar Shah and the promoter group declared no encumbrance of Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Limited shares during FY2026.
Shekhar Rasiklal Somani (promoter) and promoter group declared no share encumbrances during FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹217.32 Cr (+75.9% YoY), net profit ₹21.45 Cr (+116.2% YoY).
Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Limited cancelled its earnings call scheduled for 19 October 2026 at 05:00 PM (IST) due to unforeseen circumstances.
On 19 October 2026, Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem released its Q2FY27 investor presentation highlighting record quarterly revenue.
